newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel seeks freight shuttle start - paper.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel seeks freight shuttle start - paper.

text.p: Anglo-French channel tunnel operator Eurotunnel Plc/SA plans to start an experimental freight shuttle service when the fire-damaged south tunnel is re-opened on Wednesday, the Financial Times said on Monday.
The newspaper said road hauliers will be invited to send lorries through the tunnel free of charge, pending the start of a commercial service in mid-June.
The resumption of freight shuttles depends on the Anglo-French safety authority approving the use of the open lattice design for truck carriers -- a design condemned by the UK fire service.

Eurotunnel, however, is confident that its improvements to the design and new safety procedures unveiled last month will allow the safety authority to give the go-ahead of services to resume, the Financial Times said.
